entities.name: Query IspD-IspF
observations: 386 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 40.70 kDa and theoretical pI 6.20.
Contains Pfam IspD domain PF01128 at residues 5-224 and YgbB domain PF02542 at residues 230-382; NTP_transf_3 PF12804 spans residues 6-132.
Has 57.4-60.6% identity and approximately full-length coverage to reviewed bifunctional IspD/IspF homologs Q2W4Q8, Q2RTS1, and A7HXV6.
Strongly inferred to catalyze IspD formation of 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol and IspF formation of 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate with CMP release.
Associated with the non-mevalonate/DXP isoprenoid biosynthesis pathway, steps 2 and 4; likely requires a divalent metal cation.
No transmembrane segment or obvious signal peptide is evident from the sequence; soluble bacterial enzyme is the likely localization.
Functional assignment is homology-supported rather than direct biochemical characterization of this exact sequence.

entities.name: IspD reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate + CTP + H+ → 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:13429; EC 2.7.7.60.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The inferred enzyme acts in the methylerythritol 4-phosphate/DXP pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis, corresponding to steps 2 and 4 of the pathway.

entities.name: Divalent metal requirement
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate a divalent metal cation as a cofactor; the exact metal ion and requirement for this query protein are inferred, not experimentally established.
